title: Kindling setup flow — micro-illustrations and annotated screenshots for quant & cache recommendations
creator: Maya Gonzalez
description: Create a compact, stepwise setup flow aimed at first-run users who enable the Optimize toolkit. Deliver: a set of 6 micro-illustrations (themed 'Kindling' metaphors), 4 annotated product screenshots highlighting batching, KV cache recommendations and quantization options, and a concise in-product tooltip copy pack. Focus on clear affordances for safe defaults, where the UI surfaces recommended quant profiles and an estimated per-token cost delta with an inline preview.
acceptance_criteria: Six vector-friendly micro-illustrations (SVG) following Kindling theme, exported at 2x and 3x for retina SDKs
Four annotated screenshots: (1) Batching suggestions panel, (2) KV cache heatmap overlay, (3) Quantization profile selector with risk badge, (4) Quick-run preview modal with cost/latency est.
Tooltip copy set (desktop + mobile) with A/B variants for language that mentions 'estimated token savings' and 'quality guardrails'
Handoff file (Figma) with redlines and assets packaged in Drive + image sprite sheet for web engineers
Design QA pass completed with ENG-8890 and PM signoff (PM-4123)
All assets referenced in a short Confluence runbook for A/B rollout and telemetry hooks

decisions: Use a single 'Kindling' visual theme across onboarding to create an associative motif for cost-saving features
Expose quantization as a recommended profile with an inline 'risk band' indicator rather than burying it in advanced settings
Show estimated cost delta in both absolute tokens and percentage to help teams of different sizes interpret impact
Bundle KV cache suggestions into a single card that surfaces hit-rate projection and suggested TTLs

ui_copy_samples: Conservative quant label: 'Balanced (recommended) — saves ~15% tokens; minimal quality change'
Performance quant label: 'Aggressive — saves ~30% tokens; preview recommended for hallucination-sensitive prompts'
Batching tooltip: 'Automatic batching groups similar requests to improve throughput. Turn off for strict latency budgets.'
KV cache CTA: 'Enable prefix caching to reduce repeated prefix compute; suggested TTL: 12h (projects like chatbot flows).'
Risk badge aria-label: 'Quantization risk: low/medium/high — consult preview to verify output quality.'
